messages:
Sam (Sales): FYI EdgeCorp signed the NDA and wants a 2-week private/on-prem POC. asking for install prereqs + timeline. who can own the readiness checklist?
Alan (PreSales): I can own the preflight checklist. quick questions: k8s or single-node VM? and do they want Dedicated pool afterwards?
Miguel (Infra Eng): They said k8s (managed cluster). I'll need kubeconfig with a service account or SSH to a bastion to run checks.
Sam (Sales): I'll request a read-only kubeconfig and a point of contact. timeline target: start deploy next Tue.
Alan (PreSales): Core prereqs (short list): NVIDIA driver >= 520, CUDA >= 11.8, nvidia-container-toolkit or NVIDIA GPU Operator, container runtime compatible with CRI (containerd/docker shim ok), kernel >= 5.4, k8s >= 1.24, nodes labeled for inference. Also need 200GB local SSD per GPU node for model cache.
Jenna (SRE): Add: cgroup driver=systemd on kubelet, swap disabled, mtu/default CNI tested. If SELinux/enforcing, we need to validate runtime flags.
Claire (Security): From security POV: outbound access allowed only to control plane (control-plane.redwood-inference.svc:443) for license handshake? They need to confirm egress rules and provide KMS access plan for keys. Also will run our minimal threat checklist on their network.
Miguel (Infra Eng): I'll send a small preflight script they can run and paste results. it checks: 
```
# run on each node
cat /etc/os-release
uname -r
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv
kubectl version --short
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system
df -h /var/lib/model-cache
```
Alan (PreSales): perfect. also need these k8s labels/taints applied for scheduling: 
```
kubectl label nodes <node> redwood.io/inference=enabled
kubectl taint nodes <node> redwood.io/inference=true:NoSchedule  # optional
```
Miguel (Infra Eng): For private installer we prefer using our Helm chart + values file. I'll attach chart link in a follow-up. Installer requires a service account with cluster-admin for initial bootstrap (can be revoked after).
Sam (Sales): Customer asked about Hosted API keys while on-prem POC — can we provide a temporary limited key for telemetry?
Alan (PreSales): We can provide a scoped key with telemetry disabled. For POC networking we also support an air-gapped install if they can't egress, but that's longer (2-3 days extra, need image bundle + offline license).
Claire (Security): If they want air-gapped, we'll need an allowlist for IPs and a signed installer bundle. security questionnaire item: provide info on KMS/HSM integration options and audit log retention.
Jenna (SRE): Quick note on GPU stuff: recommended driver >= 525 for best cuBLAS/TF perf with Ampere+; CUDA 11.8 minimum, some models want 12.x but we have quantized variants. Please include `nvidia-container-toolkit` or enable NVIDIA GPU Operator.
Miguel (Infra Eng): I'll run the preflight remotely if they give kubeconfig + SSH. Target to finish checks by EOD Fri.
deploy-bot: helm release "redwood-inference" created in namespace redwood-system (v0.9.2) — test chart queued.
Sam (Sales): Thanks. I'll request kubeconfig + SOC point + schedule. cc @Claire for the security questionnaire handoff.
Claire (Security): I'll review once they share the completed questionnaire. quick ask: include kernel version and whether FIPS is enabled.
Alan (PreSales): I'll DM the preflight script and a sample values.yaml. short POC success criteria: model loading on GPU, <120ms token latency on 4xA10 node, and stable memory w/ batching.
Sam (Sales): Great — I'll update EdgeCorp and post back with their kubeconfig when they provide it. :thumbsup:
Miguel (Infra Eng): :eyes: on the kubeconfig. once we have it I'll run `nvidia-smi` remote and validate drivers + run the installer in dry-run mode.
Jenna (SRE): If anything blocks, call out the exact kube/node output lines. those are easiest to triage.
Sam (Sales): closing the loop — target start date Tue EOD if preflight passes. thanks everyone.
